value.0: A navigation key pulled from a navigation core. It holds the coordinates of an unstable tier 1 rift pocket. Use it in space, out of combat, to open the pocket for your ship and up to 2 party ships within 30 m. Clear its three chambers within 15 minutes: the faster you finish, the more it pays. If time runs out the pocket collapses and everyone aboard ejects in escape pods. The key is spent when the pocket opens.
